title: Functional-space trust-region readout: no-training oracle projection audit
environment: laptop_28358lan; python C:/Users/28358/anaconda3/envs/pytorch/python.exe; vendor D:/coco_wire/vendor_8.4.100 (ultralytics 8.4.100); torch 2.5.1; RTX 4060 Laptop
question: Under no additional network information, does the functional-space constraint (evidence-region fit plus protected-region penalty) retain most of the oracle gain while substantially reducing perturbation of already-reliable regions?
panel: 197-image historical dev panel reusing RUN_COEFF_ALIGN_EXPORT_S0_R1; 1,375 GT-associated one-to-one candidates (663 native-failure / 712 native-success; 1,239 with positive oracle gain)
outcome_scope: The trust-region projection retains only 30.2% of oracle IoU gain (gate 80%), retains less than a random same-cardinality support control (58.8%), while the protection term is highly effective (protected-zone logit change 6.2% of the oracle's own, gate passed); no lambda configuration in the pre-registered sensitivity set reaches the retention gate; the route is stopped per the pre-registered rule without parameter chasing
verification_scope: 7/7 independent checks passed (augmented-least-squares re-solve, IoU/retention recomputation, primary regression, gate labels, sensitivity distinctness)
limits: historical dev panel, not a blind test; diagnostic association, not COCO matching; no AP claim
m_E=m_R=1.0 first-version fixed engineering choice; conclusions limited to this construction family
stop per pre-registered gate does not prove all functional-space methods ineffective
